subject: POC trial planning & workload intake - Acme Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>, Mike Liu <mike.liu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: POC trial planning & workload intake - Acme Health

Hi Sara / Mike —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed POC plan so we can align on success criteria and next steps. TL;DR: we should be ready to start a 4-week POC the week of May 25 if you can provide staging access and a sample workload profile this week.

Success criteria (proposed) — please confirm or edit:
- Latency: 95th percentile under 300ms for 512-token requests during steady state
- Throughput: sustain 50 RPS for inference with bursts to 200 RPS up to 2 minutes
- Cost: unit cost per 1k tokens under your target (we'll include cost breakdown in the POC report)
- Functional: model outputs meet your intent metrics on the provided evaluation set (we'll run a small eval pass)

Evaluation plan:
- Week 0 (prep): ingest sample workload + provide staging endpoints and credentials; Redwood sets up dedicated test pool
- Week 1: baseline runs with current model variant and collection of perf/quality metrics
- Week 2: tuning (batching, cache, quantization suggestion) + re-run evals
- Week 3: stability testing (burst and concurrency scenarios) + final report and recommendations

Ownership:
- Redwood: technical setup, monitoring dashboards, perf/quality evals, SRE on-call for POC window (Ben, Marissa)
- Acme Health: provide sample workload, test accounts, staging API keys, definition of success and any legal/PO approvals (Sara / Mike)

Immediate asks from Acme Health (if you can send by EOD Fri):
1) Workload profile (CSV or brief): RPS (average / peak), typical token lengths (avg / 95th), concurrency targets, burst patterns (duration / frequency), payload sizes
2) Staging endpoint and test API key (or a secure method to share credentials)
3) Any constraints: IP allowlists, egress rules, or data residency notes

Attachments: I can attach a short POC SOW + template if helpful — will send once we confirm timeline.

Proposed kickoff: Tue May 25, 09:00 PT (60 min technical kickoff) — please confirm availability.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Liu <mike.liu@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC trial planning & workload intake - Acme Health

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear plan. Confirming we want to proceed with the 4-week POC and the May 25 kickoff. Quick answers to your immediate asks and a couple notes:

Workload profile (summary):
- Avg RPS: 22
- Sustained RPS target for POC (we want Redwood to support): 50 RPS
- Peak bursts: up to 220 RPS, typically lasting 60-120s, happens ~3x/day during business hours
- Avg token length (user prompt + system): 280 tokens
- 95th percentile token length: ~1,800 tokens (long clinical summaries)
- Concurrency: expect 40 concurrent inference sessions at peak
- Payload size: avg 6KB JSON payload

We're attaching a small sample_workload.csv (sanitized) and a network_topology.pdf showing our staging VPC egress rules.

Staging credentials: we prefer to share via our secret manager or a secure link; I'll coordinate a short-lived test key and send the link to Ben directly (not in this thread).

Legal/PO: procurement asked whether Redwood can accept our standard SOW template. We'll review the POC SOW when you send it; Legal (legal@acmehealth.com) will be on the loop for any redlines.

Two asks for Redwood before kickoff:
- Can you confirm how Redwood will handle the 95th percentile long-token cases (1,800 tokens)? Any pre-emptive guidance around batching/quantization that might impact quality?
- Do you need IP allowlist ranges from our side prior to the kickoff?

We'll aim to provide the staging key link by Monday.

Sara Jenkins
Head of Integrations
Acme Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mike Liu <mike.liu@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 12:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC trial planning & workload intake - Acme Health

Sara — perfect, thanks for the details and the attachments. Quick responses inline and next steps: 

- Long token handling (1,800 tokens): Redwood's runtime supports variable-length sequences; for very long 95th-percentile requests we'll do two things during the POC: (1) run baseline perf with your long requests to capture real latency; (2) evaluate a quantized variant and tuned batching profile to see if we can hit the latency SLO without degrading quality. We'll include quality regression checks on your eval set for each tuning pass.

- IP allowlist: yes, please share your egress IP ranges if you require allowlisting. We'll provide the Redwood pool IPs ahead of the kickoff.

Action items from Redwood (we'll complete before kick):
1) Share POC_SOW_v1.pdf (attached) and HubSpot deal link for tracking
2) Provision a dedicated test pool and baseline dashboards (Marissa will own config)
3) Prepare a short eval harness and a prompt set to run against your sample workload

Can you confirm the May 25 09:00 PT slot? If so we'll send an invite and the meeting agenda (tech kickoff + data handoff + success criteria alignment).

Ben

- We'll upload the staging key to the secure link Sara will share. Expect a 14-day test key with limited scopes (inference-only).
- For long requests (~1,800 tokens) we care more about stable tail latency than microsecond improvements. If Redwood can demonstrate predictable 95th/99th percentiles under load, that's sufficient for our evaluation criteria.
- Please include a short appendix in the POC report describing how Redwood quantization could impact output fidelity (example failure modes).

Attached is a signed_sow_stub.pdf (placeholder) — legal will follow with the official SOW if there are no material redlines.

See you on Tuesday.
